'''Bid'jerma''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
This world was the site of an [[Bid'jerma Detention Block|Imperial Detention Block]]. The [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] established an [[Outpost Cinder|outpost]] near this facility in order to recover Rebels imprisoned there.<ref name="HS" />
